caption: The drawing depicts a single translucent glass pitcher with a wide mouth and an ornate, curving handle attached to its body. The pitcher is rendered in shades of light blue and aqua, with highlights and shadows indicating its glassy, reflective surface. The vessel has a bulbous midsection tapering toward the base, which sits on a round, flat foot. Decorative raised patterns, resembling swirling vines or waves, adorn the body of the pitcher. The handle features an additional decorative element where it meets the body. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist's signature "Brodsky" appears in the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Large Pitcher
